ambiguities.topic: Banded quantity rebate: counting period and ordering
readings: Schedule 4 Part 3 (which states 'Clause 30 is substituted' and, as a Schedule, prevails over the General Conditions under Clause 2): bands restart from zero at the start of each Contract Year (3A).
Clause 30 as printed: cumulative across the whole of the Works from the Commencement Date, never reset.
ambiguities.note: Clause 30's ordering rule (date of execution, then application number, then line number) is not restated in Part 3; whether it survives the substitution is unstated. The count is per item across all work areas.

ambiguities.topic: Monthly published rates (D.41.020 under S1; E.54.010 under A2): base rate or final rate
readings: The published 'rate payable' replaces the Schedule 1 base rate and then goes through the Clause 27 build-up (zone factor for Series D, night uplift for D.41.020, discounts).
The published 'rate payable' is the final rate for the month, with no further build-up.

ambiguities.topic: D.41.020 monthly rate indexed 'per tonne' against an m2 item
readings: The published monthly figures (214.50-220.50) are rates per m2, as Supplement No. 2 treats them (unit m2, 'rate previously payable 220.50').
The figures are per-tonne index values and are not directly a per-m2 rate (Clause 26 forbids other units).
ambiguities.note: The BoQ base rate is 63.50 per m2; the monthly rates are over three times higher. Supplement No. 2 carries 220.50 forward as the per-m2 'rate previously payable', which supports the first reading.

ambiguities.topic: Supplement No. 2 5% discount and Amendment No. 2 8% discount
readings: From 2026-04-01 the 8% discount replaces the 5% (the 'later governs' closing words; recital 'deepening of the Supplement No. 2 discount').
The discounts compound (0.95 x 0.92).
ambiguities.note: The closing words of every instrument point strongly to replacement.

ambiguities.topic: Schedule 2A indexation versus the Appendix B worked example
readings: The Appendix B example prices C.31.010 on 13/05/2025 in Z2 at 91.37 (= 86.20 x 1.06), i.e. without indexation.
ambiguities.note: Appendix B is illustrative and is not listed among the Subcontract documents in Clause 2; Schedule 2A says the Schedule 1 rate 'is not payable as it stands'. The two other example lines agree with the Clause 27/28 build-up.

ambiguities.topic: Currency of the three Schedule 2B items
readings: Schedule 2B/Clause 26A govern: 38.40, 219.00 and 423.00 are USD and are converted at the Schedule 2B monthly rate before any factor.
Clause 38 and the Schedule 1 'Rate (SAR)' heading: the rates are SAR.
ambiguities.note: Clause 2 makes a later-numbered Schedule prevail over an earlier one and any Schedule prevail over the General Conditions, which favours reading one.

ambiguities.topic: Clause 27A: 'an item priced at a zone factor exceeding 1.1'
readings: No night uplift on work in Z3 (1.145) or Z4 (1.28); night uplift available in Z1 (1) and Z2 (1.06).
Some other reading of 'priced at'.
ambiguities.note: The first reading is the natural one; recorded because it removes the uplift from half the zones.

ambiguities.topic: Clause 27A: ground classification deemed G2 after 27 September 2025
readings: For all work executed after 2025-09-27, the ground factor is 1 (G2) whatever ground class the line or record states.
Only in the work areas named in the Amendment No. 1 recital (drainage corridor, compound extension).
ambiguities.note: 27A says 'that is to say for work executed after 27 September 2025' without limitation, which favours the first reading.

ambiguities.topic: Night / rest-day status and Engineer's instructions
readings: Night status is taken from the application line's night_work flag; rest-day status from the weekday of work_date.
Night status must be evidenced by the site record.
ambiguities.note: No Engineer's instruction under Clause 9 is supplied anywhere in the data, so the concurrent night+rest-day uplift (P11) can never be shown to be authorised; the site records do not state times of day.

ambiguities.topic: Consequence of a missing, unsigned or non-matching Schedule 5 record
readings: Clauses 13 and 46: the line is not payable in the application that includes it.
Clause P23 (Part V, which prevails over Parts I-III): the amount is deducted from the next valuation.
ambiguities.note: Also unresolved: whether a record lacking the Engineer's countersignature (Clause 47) counts as missing, and whether a record whose area, date or series disagrees with the line counts as evidence.

ambiguities.topic: Amendment No. 3 retroactive rate change: where the difference is shown
readings: Clause 31A: a single adjustment on the first application submitted on or after 2026-05-12, and on no other; earlier applications are not incorrect.
A3 recital: the first application submitted after 2026-05-12.
Schedule of Variations: nothing in an instrument reopens work already measured at the rate then payable.
ambiguities.note: The applications CSV has an 'adjustment' column; the judged figure is application_total, and Clause 45A places the Clause 31A adjustment outside the measured total. How an adjustment interacts with application_total is unresolved.

ambiguities.topic: Clause 45A release of retention and the judged total
readings: 45A: half of retention held on all earlier applications is released on the first application submitted after 2026-09-30.
Clause 51: release at Taking-Over Certificate / end of defects liability period.
ambiguities.note: Part VII is later and specific; it is not placed in the Clause 2 / P1 precedence chain explicitly.

readings: The billed quantity for E.51.010 / E.51.030 should equal the hours stated on the record minus one, per record.
Minus one per day or per attendance where a record covers several.
ambiguities.note: Every MO/PS record in the data states a single figure of hours for one date.

ambiguities.topic: Clause 33 (exact) versus Clause 33A (2 per cent tolerance)
readings: 33A (later, specific): up to 2% above the surveyed quantity is payable as measured; above that, only the surveyed quantity.
33: the surveyed quantity exactly.

ambiguities.topic: Clause 32 / P19 'within two days of the measurement' of A.14.010
readings: Excluded on the same day and the following two days.
Excluded on the two days following, not the same day.
Not more than 2 days per work area per day (Schedule 4 Part 4 and P6).
ambiguities.note: P6's wording ('two days per work area per day of attendance') is odd but consistent with Schedule 4.

ambiguities.topic: Clause 47A five-day rule for week items
readings: Applies to A.16.010 via the Dewatering Log's 'Days on' list.
Also applies to E.54.010 (no Schedule 5 record exists for it).

ambiguities.topic: Applications quoting a different contract reference
readings: An application quoting CW-2024-0417-CIV does not belong to this contract (check 1).
It is a clerical typo on an application otherwise belonging to this contract.
